messages:
Alice Kim: Quick escalation 1 HeliosHealth SI is blocked on Marketplace onboarding. Ingest fails during attestation because the image signature doesn't match our verifier and their registry is inside a private VPC so they can't push to our staging. Can someone pick up partner coordination + Marketplace PM sync? cc @Dan for networking.

Mateo Rivera: I'll dig into the attestation logs. Can you paste the raw error from the ingest job and the registry URL? Also who is the partner SE we should add?

Alice Kim: Raw error from their SI below: 

```
FOUND: signature: key=0xDEADBEAF status=NOT_OK
ingest: rejected - attestation verification failed
registry: https://repo.helios.internal:443/artifacts
```

Partner SE is Aaron Lim (external) 1 I'll DM him and loop back.

Priya Patel: From implementation side, two likely causes: mismatched signing key, or image mutates during CI (layers reordered or rebase). We can offer to rebuild in Redwood CI (we have a signed-image path) but need partner consent + scoped CI token or a published source tarball. Legal will need the attestation form if we sign on their behalf.

Dan Zhou: Network constraint reminder: we do not allow peering into partner VPCs for marketplace ingestion. Options: 1) partner uploads tarball to a presigned S3 URL we give them, 2) partner pushes to a temporary ECR repo we provision, or 3) we accept a vendor-provided key after key rotation validation (policy exception). See onboarding runbook: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/ingest-runbook (internal).

Mateo Rivera: The key id 0xDEADBEAF looks unfamiliar. I'll query our key registry and check previous exceptions. If it's a legacy key, we'll need a signed commit or rotation statement to accept it. Otherwise our safer path is to rebuild and sign.

deploy-bot: marketplace-ingest job failed: id=mp-ingest-9921 status=REJECTED ts=2026-03-22T09:12:34Z reason="attestation:signature_mismatch"

Priya Patel: I'll draft a short SI checklist for the partner: required artifacts (Dockerfile, base image digest, build logs), scoped CI token or tarball upload, and signed consent for Redwood to rebuild. If they prefer, we can onboard ECR access for a 48h window.

Alice Kim: Plan: Mateo to validate key and attestation path, Dan to open a tracking ticket with Marketplace PM for an exception or ECR provisioning, Priya to prep SI checklist and coordinate partner CI windows. I'll schedule a quick arc review with partner + Marketplace PM tomorrow at 11:00 PST.

Dan Zhou: Opening ticket INC-8599 to track ECR provisioning / attestation exception. I'll ping Jasper (Marketplace PM) and Legal for the attestation form.

Mateo Rivera: I'll post key audit results here before the meeting and confirm whether 0xDEADBEAF maps to a rotated key or unknown signer.

Priya Patel: Drafted checklist (summary): 1) Dockerfile + build args 2) base image digests 3) build logs + provenance 4) scoped CI token OR tarball upload 5) signed consent for rebuild/signing. Will share the full checklist in the channel shortly.

Alice Kim: Thanks all 1 adding Aaron to the invite via DM and will paste any vendor replies here. Calendar invite: "HeliosHealth marketplace attestation sync" 2026-03-22 11:00 PST.

Mateo Rivera: Seen, will be on the call.

Priya Patel: Seen, will have checklist ready.

deploy-bot: Note: mp-ingest-9921 logs archived -> s3://redwood-marketplace-logs/2026/03/22/mp-ingest-9921.log
